title: PSNL Alert: Monsey Firm of Wohl & Fruchter Investigating Fairness of the Proposed Sale of Personalis to Tempus AI
author: Wohl & Fruchter Llp
description: Law firm Wohl & Fruchter is investigating whether the Personalis board acted in shareholders' best interests regarding the proposed $16.25 per share sale to Tempus AI. Since the announcement on July 20, 2026, Personalis shares have fallen approximately 14% due to the deal's partial stock consideration and Tempus share price decline. Shareholders have expressed disappointment with the transaction.

title: PERSONALIS SHAREHOLDER ALERT: PSNL Shareholders Interested in Pursuing Potential Claims Should Contact Julie & Holleman Regarding Proposed Sale to Tempus
author: Julie & Holleman Llp
description: Law firm Julie & Holleman is investigating Personalis' proposed acquisition by Tempus AI for $16.25 per share, raising concerns about fair value and potential conflicts of interest given Tempus' existing significant equity stake and strategic partnership with Personalis since 2023.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Shareholders are being investigated for potential undervaluation concerns. The acquisition price of $16.25 per share is being questioned as potentially not reflecting the company's long-term value in the growing MRD testing market, and conflicts of interest are alleged due to the acquirer's existing ownership stake.

The company faces legal scrutiny regarding potential conflicts of interest in its acquisition of Personalis. Its preexisting ownership position and strategic relationship raise concerns about whether the acquisition process was conducted fairly and at arm's length.

title: Is Tempus AI Stock a Buy After Its CEO Sold 250,000 Shares?
author: Sara Appino
description: Tempus AI CEO Eric Lefkofsky sold 250,000 shares worth $10.5 million on July 28, 2026, reducing his stake by 4% through a pre-scheduled trading plan established in March. Despite the sale, Lefkofsky retains approximately 6.5 million shares. The article suggests this represents routine portfolio management rather than a loss of confidence, noting the company's strong Q2 2026 performance with 20% YoY revenue growth and 31% oncology volume growth, plus a strategic $1.5 billion acquisition of Personalis.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite the CEO's share sale, the article emphasizes strong fundamentals including 20% YoY revenue growth, 31% oncology volume growth, and a strategic $1.5 billion acquisition of Personalis targeting a $20 billion market opportunity. The CEO's retention of 6.5 million shares demonstrates continued alignment with shareholders. The sale is characterized as routine portfolio management rather than a loss of confidence.

Personalis is being acquired by Tempus AI for $1.5 billion, positioning it as a leader in cancer-recurrence monitoring technology within a targeted $20 billion market opportunity. This acquisition represents validation of the company's technology and strategic value.
